name: West Hook Farm Camping
accommodation: Tent and campervan camping across three fields, no hook-ups
beachAccess: About 1 mile to Marloes Sands; 500m to Martin's Haven
overview: West Hook Farm is a simple campsite near Martin's Haven, about a mile from Marloes Sands. It reopens for 2027 on 25 March, with bookings from January.
surfTripFit: Wild, simple camping a mile from Marloes Sands.
